runtime.ardy_use: standalone complete-mesh physical contact calibration; no ARDY consumed in this run; fresh native generation separate
runtime.gate_definition: v6 real physical digit surfaces, no sphere contacts

pose_reference_inverse.kind: discrete SONIC reference search using actual compiled mesh closest surfaces plus self/table penalties

history_initialization: repeat actual initial observation; action memory derived from initially held pose, no actual body command before first NN output

execution_audit.definition: Actual post-step qvel at500Hz; finite differences include solver transients. 2rad/s default and2mrad soft-limit tolerance are explicit engineering gates, not PDF/factory safety certification.

sonic_input_mode: official mode0 body-motion reference + measured-root wrist IK and bounded joint-reference feedback; no body action override
grip_geometry: closest convex surfaces of original compiled thumb/middle collision meshes, not FK markers

hand_ik.kind: material points and normals on original thumb/middle mesh; hand-only IK

grip_force_control.kind: fixed captured finger shape + independent normal closure-force regulation via real collision contact anchors; position targets only
grip_force_control.normal_frame: captured collision normal transported with the physical finger link; does not chase cube world position

contact_model: actual seven finger link collision geoms; markers collision0; no active fingertip spheres

sonic.body_action_source: official SONIC v1.1 ONNX; no manual/IK arm motor targets; optional causal decoded-target adapter separately labelled
sonic.actuator_adapter: SONIC decoded motor targets + PD; optional explicitly labelled decoded-target filter and MODEL GRAVITY ONLY on right-arm actuator torques; no manual target/generalized-force override

runtime_stamp.ardy_use: standalone complete-mesh physical contact calibration; no ARDY consumed in this run; fresh native generation separate
runtime_stamp.gate_definition: v6 real physical digit surfaces, no sphere contacts

balance.scope: support contacts only; not a COM/COP stability-margin certificate
balance.raw_force_frame: MuJoCo contact frame; f0 is normal, wrench on geom2; not signed world support force

filter.kind: C2 quintic; continue certified unchanged-goal segment; replan on changed goal
filter.continuation_rule: reject infeasible replacement; continue the remaining previously certified C2 segment; clamp future sampling time at its zero-velocity/acceleration endpoint; stop if no certified segment exists
